payloads.name: Blackwire
payloads.description: Current test beta. Stream extracted PS5 games and supported PFS/PFSC or contiguous exFAT images from up to two SMB shares on one PC. Includes setup diagnostics and the embedded reader installer. Requires a compatible jailbreak, Kstuff and ShadowMountPlus. Web interface on port 5918.
payloads.author: XXD3V3L0P3RXX
